description: Generate an importable n8n workflow JSON from a plain-words need, with every node wired in order, values said out loud already filled (emails, #channels, trigger events), plus the list of blanks only the person can fill and the credentials to connect. Shape-checked; the person tests it in n8n before turning it on. Say 'and ask me first' (or approval='always') and a one-tap approval gate — a Slack/Telegram/Gmail message with Approve / Decline buttons — goes in front of the step, so nothing is sent, posted, deleted or paid until the person taps Approve.

approval.description: auto = gate the steps the need asks to approve ('ask me first'); always = gate every irreversible step (send, post, delete, pay); never = no gates.

name.description: Workflow name shown in n8n (optional; made from the need when left out).

need.description: What should happen, in plain words. Start with 'when …' for the trigger; add 'and ask me first' before a step the person wants to approve.

name: make_n8n_workflow

approval.description: which steps got an Approve/Decline gate, through which app, and how to add one

steps.description: one per step: tool, reversibility (read-only / reversible / irreversible), approval_gate

items.description: One step: text, kind (trigger/action), the chosen tool or a gap; reversibility = read-only (changes nothing) / reversible (undo by hand) / irreversible (sends, posts, deletes, pays — out in the world), and approval_gate (an Approve/Decline message runs first).

to_fill.description: blanks only the person can fill

title: Make an importable n8n workflow
